info.name: ATHENA functional correctness — isolated local endpoints
info.description: Workbook case IDs label requests and assertions. Synthetic local session setup is not a Google login test. State checks use a key-protected loopback-only fixture oracle. Imported collections require the generated private local environment. No deployed mutation is supported.

exec: const target = pm.environment.get('baseURL'); if (!new RegExp('^http://(127[.]0[.]0[.]1|localhost):[0-9]+$').test(target || '') || !pm.environment.get('fixtureKey')) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Refusing nonlocal functional fixture execution.'); }
